title: Router SQL Avatica protobuf forwarding buffers full request body in memory

deployment_plan.preferred_source: official Docker image / Docker quickstart compose
deployment_plan.reason: The repository docker-compose.yml references apache/druid:38.0.0, but docker.io had no such manifest at validation time. The latest locally available official release image is apache/druid:37.0.0, with the same Router Avatica protobuf buffering path.
harness_changes: Removed fixed container_name values to avoid interfering with other workers.
Bound host ports to 127.0.0.1 and shifted host port numbers for isolation.
Started only the Router/Broker/Coordinator/Postgres/ZooKeeper subset required for this Router-to-Broker Avatica path.

probe_plan.attacker_model: anonymous local HTTP client against default unauthenticated quickstart Router
probe_plan.payload: Valid Avatica protobuf OpenConnectionRequest plus protobuf unknown length-delimited padding field.
stop_conditions: Router JVM exits or logs OutOfMemoryError / GC overhead
Router /status/health remains unavailable across repeated checks
HTTP body-size rejection appears before proportional buffering
Configured body size or time cap is reached

static_traceability.sink: AsyncQueryForwardingServlet.service reads the full InputStream into byte[] requestBytes and stores it as AVATICA_QUERY_ATTRIBUTE for proxying.
static_traceability.driver: Avatica protobuf request body byte volume; repeated concurrent requests retain byte arrays during broker selection/proxy forwarding.
evidence: services/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/server/AsyncQueryForwardingServlet.java:232-237 buffers avatica protobuf request body and stores it in a request attribute.
services/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/server/AsyncQueryForwardingServlet.java:441-443 reuses the retained byte[] as BytesRequestContent.
server/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/server/initialization/jetty/JettyServerModule.java:227 sets request header size, with no reviewed body-size setting nearby.
missing_evidence: Official default Router exposure for Avatica protobuf in target deployment.
Runtime maximum accepted protobuf/request body size.
